subject: Throughput validation request & short-term price commitment
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment?

Karthik —

Quick note from my side: we’ve had an inbound from a competitor pushing a lower headline price and promising a 2x throughput baseline for our busiest endpoints. Our SREs ran a quick synthetic and saw that the competitor looks good on the narrow test; however we know those aren’t always representative.

Before procurement moves anything, Procurement (CC) asked if Redwood can commit to: 1) a short-term price hold for 90 days while we validate; and 2) a throughput validation run on our production-like workload with your team present. If you can provide a concrete plan + an estimated time window this week, we can keep this in-house.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call this afternoon.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform — NovaRetail
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaretail.com>
Cc: Maya Lin <maya.lin@novaretail.com>, procurement@novaretail.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment?

Daniel —

Thanks for the flag. We can absolutely run a production-like throughput validation and offer a 90-day price commitment while that run is scheduled. Proposed next steps:

- We’ll execute a targeted throughput validation using a shadowed copy of your peak traffic profile (non-invasive).
- Timeline: kickoff call + test plan tomorrow; test window as early as Friday (Jul 30) or Monday depending on your windows.
- Deliverables: test plan PDF, test results (CSV), an ops runbook for any fallbacks, and a 90-day term sheet for the price hold.

I’m attaching a draft test plan and a one-page term sheet for the price-lock. If that looks reasonable I’ll loop in Rishi and Laura to fast-track capacity and legal approvals.

Attachments: novaretail-throughput-test-plan.pdf, price-lock-term-sheet.pdf

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Maya Lin <maya.lin@novaretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment?

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of asks from infra:

- Can Redwood run the test against a staging cluster that mirrors our production request distribution? We don’t want to risk customer-facing impact.
- We’ll need a written runbook for rollback and a 2-hour maintenance window to start.
- Procurement wants the price-lock doc to include a one-time exit fee if NovaRetail terminates early (they’re skittish after recent migrations).

If you can incorporate these items into the plan, I’ll clear the scheduling on our side.

—Maya
Maya Lin
Principal SRE — NovaRetail
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Lin <maya.lin@novaretail.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaretail.com>, procurement@novaretail.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment? — test plan updated

Maya / Daniel —

Updated plan attached: we’ll run the validation on a staging cluster that mirrors production traffic distribution and hold a 2-hour window. The attached test plan includes: test traffic profile, measurement KPIs (p95 latency, tail QPS, error injection checks), and rollback steps.

On the price-lock: term sheet updated to include a modest exit fee (one month's committed spend) if NovaRetail cancels before 90 days. Laura, Rishi — can you review the attached and confirm we can commit capacity for the Friday window (Jul 30)? If legal needs changes, please flag.

Attachments: novaretail-throughput-test-plan.pdf, price-lock-term-sheet.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 06:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Re: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment? — capacity check

Karthik —

I reviewed the plan. We can provision a dedicated burst pool for the Friday run (4 x A100-equivalent) and reserve it for the 2-hour window. Ops will stand by and we’ll stream metrics into the same Grafana dashboard your team will get access to. A few caveats:

- If the test pushes >3M concurrent tokens/s in tail scenarios, we’ll throttle at the infra edge and note it in results.
- If NovaRetail insists on an exact mirror of production peak that spans 6+ hours, we need to split into staged runs; Friday is limited to 2 hours.

I’ll prep the lab-results-2027-07-30.csv once the run completes.

Rishi
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Lin <maya.lin@novaretail.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaretail.com>, procurement@novaretail.com
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput numbers and short-term commitment? — confirmed next steps and pricing

Team —

We completed the Friday validation and the metrics are attached (lab-results-2027-07-30.csv). High level: tail latency stayed within SLA at target QPS for the requested 2-hour window; we observed a 12% efficiency delta vs the competitor’s narrow test in their favored pattern, and we captured heap/IO traces as requested. Rishi included notes in the CSV.

Per procurement: Redwood will extend a 90-day price-lock at the proposed rate, with the one-month exit fee described in the term sheet. I’ve routed the updated term sheet for e-signature (DocuSign link below). Once signed, we’ll schedule a post-validation runbook review with NovaRetail’s SREs and hand over long-term capacity options (Reserved pools or Dedicated).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/novaretail-rd-3482
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3482

Action items:
- Daniel / Maya: sign the term sheet (procurement) — target EOD Thu.
- Karthik: send commitment PO once DocuSign is complete.
- Rishi: upload final traces to the shared drive (done).

Thanks all — we’ll follow up in a short call to close.

—Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
